name: design-taste-gate-routing-and-review
description: Routing and quality prompts for the Design Taste Gate skill.

cases.prompt: Use $design-taste-gate to review this landing page concept: centered hero, purple-blue gradient, Inter font, three rounded cards, and CTA copy that says "Unlock seamless insights".
expected: Triggers design-taste-gate
Flags generic AI UI tells without treating them as absolute bans
Recommends concrete composition, typography, color, and CTA changes
Keeps response concise

cases.prompt: Use $design-taste-gate on a dense SaaS operations dashboard with filters, a data table, KPIs, alerts, and no visual hierarchy.
expected: Classifies the surface as product UI or dashboard
Prioritizes scanability, density, hierarchy, and state clarity
Does not recommend marketing-page spectacle
Hands off to frontend-ux for implementation or state-coverage gaps if needed

cases.prompt: This settings page has long helper text under every toggle and vague buttons. Use the right skill to improve it.
expected: Routes primarily to ux-writer for copy issues
Mentions design-taste-gate only if density or hierarchy causes the copy problem
Preserves UX Writer boundary as the owner of user-facing words

cases.prompt: Review this single-file HTML decision matrix before I share it with a collaborator. It needs to be easier to scan and less generic.
expected: Triggers design-taste-gate
Treats the surface as a local human-facing artifact
References Shareables as the durable artifact lane when packaging or public-safety review is needed
Focuses on hierarchy, comparison, controls, print/readability, and generic visual tells

cases.prompt: Polish this ChatGPT Apps SDK widget that uses MCP tools and a small React UI.
expected: Uses design-taste-gate for final visual/craft review
Hands off to chatgpt-apps for Apps SDK tool/widget architecture
Does not confuse Claude web artifacts with ChatGPT Apps SDK widgets

cases.prompt: Explain in Markdown when to use a button versus a link.
expected: Does not trigger design-taste-gate or artifact-building
Returns a direct Markdown answer
Does not overbuild into Shareables or a frontend artifact

cases.prompt: Use $design-taste-gate to review a visually striking form with low-contrast labels, no focus states, animated validation, and generic error messages.
expected: States that taste does not outrank usability
Flags accessibility and state issues before decorative polish
Hands off to frontend-ux and ux-writer where appropriate
Provides concrete fixes
